lineage.rule_text: Two registered entries join one lineage component when a chain of recorded ancestry edges (INIT: weights continued from a parent; TEACHER: a parent's predictions used as labels; PSEUDO_SOURCE: a parent's outputs or embeddings steered pseudo-labels) connects them, in either direction. Sharing a training scroll does not join components; it is reported separately. Edges are counted at two strengths: VERIFIED edges only, and VERIFIED plus INFERRED edges. UNVERIFIED edges never join.

verified_and_inferred_edges.sentence: 6 of 9 registered entries joined the same lineage component under rule shared_ancestry_v1 (VERIFIED and INFERRED edges). Ink detectors among them: 1. Entries that are not ink detectors are counted separately by role: 2 backbone, 3 fiber_segmenter. The component also holds 3 unreleased ancestor node(s) recorded from source text. Registered entries with no recorded ancestry sit in singleton components; that is the absence of a record, not evidence of independence.

verified_edges.sentence: 5 of 9 registered entries joined the same lineage component under rule shared_ancestry_v1 (VERIFIED edges only). Ink detectors among them: 1. Entries that are not ink detectors are counted separately by role: 2 backbone, 2 fiber_segmenter. The component also holds 1 unreleased ancestor node(s) recorded from source text. Registered entries with no recorded ancestry sit in singleton components; that is the absence of a record, not evidence of independence.

not_shown: anything a cited source is silent about (UNVERIFIED)
independence: no recorded ancestry is not independence
